content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, `(*service).ExtractAll` (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`), which does a single goldmark AST walk over the memo's raw markdown content. This is invoked via the helper `RebuildMemoPayload` in `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which writes the results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (a `storepb.MemoPayload_Property`, defined in `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`).

**Triggers (recomputation points):**
- `CreateMemo` — every new memo, called at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` right after building the store record and before persisting it.
- `UpdateMemo` — only when the update mask includes the `content` field, called at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (inside the `path == "content"` branch of the update-mask loop). Updating other fields (visibility, pinned, state, etc.) does not recompute it.
- There's also a batch/backfill path, `Runner.RunOnce` in `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`, which pages through all memos and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` on each — but nothing in the current codebase calls `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` (no cron/CLI wiring found), so it appears to be a dormant/manual migration tool rather than an active trigger.

**Extracted properties:**
- `Tags []string` — all `#tag` occurrences found via the tag AST extension (deduplicated, case-preserved).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block-level node if it's an H1 heading (`extractHeadingText`, markdown.go:172-179, 383-389).
- `Property.HasLink` — set if any Markdown link node exists.
- `Property.HasCode` — set if any code block, fenced code block, or code span exists.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — set if any task checkbox node exists.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — set if any task checkbox is unchecked.
- (`ExtractAll` also collects `Mentions []string` from `@mention` nodes, though these are used separately for inbox notifications in `memo_mention_helpers.go` rather than stored on the memo payload.)

## Summary

This repo is [usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos) (Go backend, React frontend). Derived/computed metadata for memos is entirely a **backend** concern (no ORM hooks/triggers — it's done in application code, invoked explicitly from the gRPC service handlers). It falls into two categories: metadata that is **persisted** on create/update, and metadata that is **computed on-the-fly** every time a memo is serialized for an API response (used for list previews).

### 1. Where it's computed

**Core extraction logic** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` (lines 356-422) — single-pass goldmark AST walk that derives:
  - `Tags` — from `#tag` AST nodes (line 376-378)
  - `Mentions` — from `@mention` AST nodes (line 379-381)
  - `Property.Title` — extracted from the **first H1 heading** if it's the first block in the doc (lines 384-389, helper `extractHeadingText` at line 172-179)
  - `Property.HasLink` — true if any Markdown link node exists (line 393-394)
  - `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span exists (line 396-397)
  - `Property.HasTaskList` / `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — from GFM task-list checkbox nodes (lines 399-405)
- `ExtractTags` (142-170) and `ExtractProperties` (192-241) are standalone equivalents of parts of `ExtractAll`.
- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` (lines 263-346) — walks the AST, strips code blocks, concatenates text/links/tags, and truncates at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 470-489) to produce a plain-text preview/excerpt.

**Where the persisted fields get (re)computed and written to the memo's payload** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`
```go
// lines 74-88
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
	}
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```
This same file also defines a `Runner` type with `RunOnce(ctx)` (lines 26-72) that batches through **all** memos in the DB (100 at a time) and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each — i.e., a bulk-recompute job. Note: I checked `server/server.go`'s `startBackgroundRunners` (lines 153-174) and only the `s3presign` runner is actually scheduled there; `memopayload.NewRunner`/`RunOnce` is **not wired up anywhere** in the current codebase (no cron, no CLI command, no callers found via grep). It appears to be a dormant/available maintenance tool rather than something that currently runs automatically.

**Snippet/excerpt used for list previews and notifications** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` lines 83-90:
```go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
	snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
	...
}
```
This is called from `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (lines 76-80, and again for related lists at lines 225 and 248), from `user_service_notifications.go:323`, and from `memo_relation_service.go:154/162` — i.e., **every time a memo is converted from a store row to an API response**, not stored in the DB.

### 2. What triggers recomputation

- **On memo create**: `CreateMemo` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` before persisting, so `Payload.Tags` and `Payload.Property` are computed once and stored at creation time.
- **On memo content update**: `UpdateMemo` in the same file, lines 435-448 — only when the update mask includes the `"content"` path:
  ```go
  if path == "content" {
      ...
      memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
      if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil { ... }
      update.Content = &memo.Content
      update.Payload = memo.Payload
  }
  ```
  So tags/title/has_link/has_code/has_task_list/has_incomplete_tasks are recomputed **only when content actually changes**, not on every field update (e.g., updating visibility or pinned alone does not recompute).
- **Snippet/excerpt (`Snippet` field)** is recomputed on **every read/serialization** — no persistence, no explicit trigger event; it's derived fresh each time a memo is converted to the API response shape (list views, get-by-id, related-memo lookups, notification payloads).
- **Bulk rebuild** via `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` exists as a batch-processing utility (100 memos per batch) but is not currently invoked by any scheduler, CLI command, or migration in this codebase (verified via repo-wide grep) — it would need to be wired in manually to run, e.g., for a backfill/migration scenario.
- There are no ORM-level hooks (no `BeforeSave`/`BeforeCreate` GORM-style callbacks) and no DB triggers — this is a plain relational store (`/bench/repo/store/memo.go` + `store/db/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}/memo.go`) with no computed-column logic; all derivation happens in the Go service layer described above.

### 3. What specific fields are derived

Persisted in `memo.Payload` (proto: `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` lines 7-29, generated Go: `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go`):
- `tags []string` — all `#tag` occurrences in content
- `property.title string` — text of the first H1 heading (only if it's the very first block)
- `property.has_link bool`
- `property.has_code bool`
- `property.has_task_list bool`
- `property.has_incomplete_tasks bool`

Computed on-demand (not persisted):
- `Snippet` (plain-text excerpt/preview, max 64 chars, truncated at word boundary) — exposed on the API `Memo` message (`convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`, `memo_service_converter.go:76-80`)
- `Mentions` (`@username` extraction) — used transiently to resolve notification targets (`memo_mention_helpers.go:26-38`), not stored on the memo payload itself.

No word-count or reading-time field exists anywhere in the repo (verified via grep across Go and web/src) — the derived preview metadata is limited to title, tags, link/code/task-list flags, and the 64-character snippet.</result>
